text:
Hello everyone 🙏
Long post ahead, thank you so much to anyone who reads and helps. 

We are a Romanian–Israeli couple and we received a refusal for the unmarried partner B1 visa after the simultaneous interview. The decision seems based mostly on misunderstandings and small inconsistencies, not lack of relationship proof.

We were given 21 days to submit an appeal, so we believe we still have a real chance.

Questions:

• Can the appeal be submitted without a lawyer? Has

anyone succeeded this way?

• If you used a lawyer, how much did the full appeal cost?

• What evidence helped your appeal succeed? What should we include? (We already have tickets, photos, chats, calls, visits, etc.)

• Do we send the appeal by email or do we need to go in person to the office? (Akko)

• If you appealed, were you successful and how long did it take?

•We saw there is an appeal fee of 774 ILS — does this fee apply to this type of appeal if we submit it ourselves without a lawyer?

Main reasons mentioned in the refusal (they seem like misunderstandings):

1. Friends vs coworkers confusion

I was asked if I have friends at work, while my partner was asked about my coworkers. He mentioned the same people I work with, which shows he knows them — the issue seems to come from automatic translation from Hebrew to Romanian.

2. Work schedule confusion

He said I worked the day before the interview (I didn’t), but he correctly mentioned my real working hours (07:00–19:00). It looks like a simple mistake due to stress.

3. Meeting with friends 

They mentioned that when I met my friend, my partner wasn’t in Romania.

In reality, he was visiting Romania 29 Dec – 6 Jan, and we met my friends together during that period. We have flight tickets, photos and messages that prove this.

4. Who knows about the relationship

Sensitive topic: he is Druze.

I mentioned other relatives who know me from video calls, but he avoided mentioning extended family due to fear they might contact his parents.

5. Family acceptance

He was asked specifically about his parents and said they might not accept if they knew.

I was asked about family members who know me, and those who know me accept the relationship. It seems PIBA generalized this to “family does not accept”.

6. Apartment description (last place we slept)

It is a rented apartment. We gave slightly different details about windows/curtains — even I didn’t remember correctly.

Any advice or experiences would help us a lot.

Thank you so much 🙏
